summary.text: John Kulewicz is the Democratic nominee. He is a Columbus attorney who spent more than four decades as a litigator at Vorys, Sater, Seymour and Pease and has served on the Upper Arlington City Council since 2020. He says he would focus the Attorney General's office on consumer fraud, price-fixing and public corruption rather than what he calls culture-war cases.

paragraphs.text: Bachelor's degree in American history from the Ohio State University and law degree from Yale Law School.
Clerked for a federal judge for one year, then worked as a litigator in Columbus for over 40 years, including cases before the U.S. Supreme Court and the Ohio Supreme Court.
Elected to the Upper Arlington City Council in 2020; former president of the Columbus Chapter of the Federal Bar Association.
